name: careers-page
title: Careers Page - Roles, Values, Teams, Benefits And A Way On, With The Empty State Handed In
description: A complete careers screen composing the roles list, three optional sets of titled things and a closing way on. The roles band is never conditional: it is given the caller's empty state and renders it in place of the rows, so a week with no vacancies still says who the company is and how to reach it. Every string, number, destination and count label is a prop.
